task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for EXT-02 at src/design/ext-02-webhook-event-dispatch.md. Define end-to-end webhook subscription and delivery architecture for events: instance started/completed/errored and task activated/completed. Specify API contracts for POST/GET/DELETE /webhooks/subscriptions, persistence model (target_url, event_types, optional secret, status, retry metadata), authz requirement PLATFORM_ADMIN, and audit hooks to OBS-03 for create/delete operations. Define dispatch pipeline semantics including payload schema, independent fan-out to multiple subscriptions, at-least-once delivery behavior, exponential backoff retries capped at 5 attempts, timeout/non-2xx handling, and per-subscription retry isolation. Specify cryptographic signing contract for optional secret using HMAC-SHA256 with X-BPM-Signature: sha256=<digest>. Define pause policy after 5 consecutive failures and mandatory OBS-06 alert trigger, plus recovery/reactivation considerations. Include module boundaries and concrete implementation touchpoints across api, engine/event emission, extensions/webhook dispatcher, persistence, and observability modules. Include a complete requirement traceability matrix mapping all EXT-02 acceptance criteria and edge cases to modules/functions and required tests (unit + integration). Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design fully maps all EXT-02 acceptance criteria and edge cases to concrete behavior
Webhook API, storage schema, and authz/audit expectations are explicit and testable
Dispatch/retry/backoff/pause semantics are precisely defined per subscription
HMAC signing contract and payload/header specification are complete
Traceability matrix identifies implementation modules and verification hooks

result.summary: Design artefact for EXT-02 webhook event dispatch completed with API contracts, persistence model, signing/retry/pause semantics, observability integration, and full traceability.
